messages:
carla: quick ping — PR 31244 needs final signoffs before tomorrow's merge window (10:00am PT). It's the batching/eviction change that touches runtime + eviction header + autoscaler. I want runtime + platform + infra + security eyeballs and a rollback plan. @alex @ben @maria @sam

alex: looking now. can I get the perf csv for the 512/2048 seq runs? if numbers look good I'll approve. also any KV cache schema changes?

ben: I can own canary + rollback steps for platform side. will schedule a canary at 08:30 PT and hold the merge until observed. need a short playbook snippet from infra for abort steps.

maria: infra here — will run infra-qa overnight. note: this touches the bpf eviction toggle; please add a feature flag so we can flip fast if we see regressions. I want the exact docker image tag pinned in the PR.

sam: security quick check — KMS callsite changed? I saw a new key wrapper import in the diff. if that's accurate, add a short threat-model note and I'll sign off after that.

carla: thanks. perf CSV attached in the PR comment (two small tables). KV schema doesn't change. KMS change is just a refactor, not new keys — I'll add the note @sam.

alex: saw CSV, p95 looks +8ms for 2048 but median unchanged. can you run one more 2048 with shorter warmup (50 iters) and include `--batch-size=8`? curious about tail behavior.

carla: yes running now, will post results in the PR thread.

deploy-bot: canary-slot reserved for 2024-07-12 08:30 PT — id=canary-142. CI: all checks passed except flaky e2e on macos (known).

ben: added canary checklist in PR description and a rollback script snippet: `./scripts/rollback_canary.sh canary-142` — confirm infra will accept manual abort.

maria: confirmed — abort is `./infra/ctl abort-canary --id canary-142`. also toggling eviction via `TUNABLE_EVICTION=off` in job config will force old behavior.

sam: added a 3-line threat-model note to PR. no secrets exfil risk spotted. waiting on final perf + infra QA artifact.

alex: perf w/ batch-size=8 uploaded. tail looks within acceptable bounds (+3ms p95). I can approve once the infra QA artifact is attached.

carla: infra artifact is uploaded as `infra-qa-31244.tar.gz` in artifacts. merging plan: my merge time = 09:10 PT if all signoffs present. rollback plan attached.

ben: I'll hang around for the merge window to coordinate canary monitoring, please ping in #oncall if anything odd. :thumbsup:

maria: if we need to abort, I can roll back the image and flip the eviction toggle within 3 minutes.

sam: security lgtm after my note.

alex: lgtm from runtime after perf check.

carla: great — thanks everyone. final: merging at 09:10 PT, canary at 08:30, full rollout deferred until 09:40 pending metrics. I'll post a quick post-merge status here.
